definitions: An assault or military action carried out by the theocratic-political-armed movement known as the Houthis, primarily referring to their actions against shipping in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden.
A specific instance of military aggression or a strike initiated by the Houthi movement.
examples: The Houthi attack caused significant disruption to global shipping.
Another Houthi attack was reported in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
International condemnation followed the latest Houthi attack.
